prior_wave_block_root_cause: Current Gemini build (boq_assistant-bard-web-server_20260525.09_p0) has NO 'Google Search' tool toggle. Upload&tools menu only exposes: Create image, Create video, Canvas, Deep research, Create music, Guided learning, Personal Intelligence.
